title: SB19, Japan's Kento Nakajima team up for cross-border collaboration on ‘Gento’
summary: P-pop group SB19 has joined forces with Japanese singer-actor Kento Nakajima for a new version of “Gento,” which is out now all digital music platforms worldwide via Sony Music Entertainment.
